name: Replicate
summary: Run open-source and official image, video, audio and language models as asynchronous predictions.
notes: Generation is asynchronous: create a prediction, then poll replicate.prediction.get with its id (or use a webhook). Prefer: wait can return a finished result in one call for quick models.
The input object differs per model; get the schema from replicate.model.get (latest_version.openapi_schema).
Billing is per second of compute or per output depending on the model.

endpoints.name: Run a model version (create a prediction)
endpoints.summary: Starts a prediction for any public model version; this is how images, video and audio are generated.

input.description: The model's input as a JSON object; its fields depend on the model.

webhook.description: HTTPS URL called as the prediction progresses.

webhook_events_filter.description: Which events call the webhook: start, output, logs, completed.

Prefer.description: Set to wait or wait=n (seconds, 1 to 60) to hold the request open until the model finishes.

Cancel_After.description: Longest the prediction may run before it is cancelled automatically.

version.description: Model identifier: owner/name for an official model, owner/name:version_id, or a bare version id.

notes: Asynchronous. The response is a prediction with an id and status starting; poll replicate.prediction.get with that id until succeeded, failed, canceled or aborted. The Prefer: wait header makes the call hold up to 60 seconds so fast models return a finished prediction directly.
A job that only produces data, so kind read. Billing depends on the model.

endpoints.name: Run an official model (create a prediction)
endpoints.summary: Starts a prediction on a model Replicate maintains, by owner and name, with no version needed.

input.description: The model's input as a JSON object; its fields depend on the model.

webhook.description: HTTPS URL called as the prediction progresses.

webhook_events_filter.description: Which events call the webhook: start, output, logs, completed.

Prefer.description: Set to wait or wait=n (seconds, 1 to 60) to hold the request open until the model finishes.

Cancel_After.description: Longest the prediction may run before it is cancelled automatically.

notes: Asynchronous: poll replicate.prediction.get with the returned id.
Official models only; for other models use replicate.prediction.create.

endpoints.name: Get a prediction
endpoints.summary: Status, output and logs of a prediction started by replicate.prediction.create or replicate.model.run.
notes: Polls the prediction started by replicate.prediction.create or replicate.model.run. status moves from starting to processing to succeeded, failed, canceled or aborted; output is set on success.

endpoints.name: List predictions

created_after.description: Only predictions created at or after this ISO 8601 time.

created_before.description: Only predictions created before this ISO 8601 time.

notes: Cursor-paginated: the response carries next and previous URLs.

endpoints.name: Get a model
endpoints.summary: Description, latest version and the input schema (in latest_version.openapi_schema) of a model.
notes: Read the input fields a model accepts from latest_version.openapi_schema before running it.

endpoints.name: Get the authenticated account
endpoints.summary: Username and type of the account the token belongs to.
